title: Tailscale host selection launcher fix
summary: Start My PC now forwards command-line arguments so the Tailscale address can be selected directly from the launcher.

changes.detail: Forward %* to start-pc-remote.mjs, enabling Start My PC.cmd --host=100.x.x.x for Tailscale sessions.

validation.name: Script inspection
validation.detail: Launcher forwards all arguments to the Node helper.

validation.name: Real device session
validation.detail: Requires the user’s Tailscale-connected Windows PC and phone.
